The fixed --version helper has process/stream waits and single owned-process termination bounds; no descendant cancellation, high-volume general native capture or other T08 lifecycle certification.

A selected existing executable whose version probe fails is reported as unusable; it does not silently switch to a different PATH installation. Only missing/invalid leaf/name and incomplete common GS installs fall through.
Found-GS version preflight failure alone has explicit master-retained result2. General conversion/email failure/result/publication semantics remain later tasks.
PS7 actual7.6.5 is behind recorded supported update7.6.6; no current-supported-build/release compatibility claim.

Native merges use short ASCII/no-space script/output paths, existing bracket source/input/output coverage and explicit child-only dependency selection. General native-space/Unicode/tool-path support remains later.

Numbered operands and page totals do not independently inspect final PDF page order or fidelity. No destination overlap/no-overwrite, PDF validation, Explorer, CI, package or release acceptance follows.
PSScriptAnalyzer remains absent/unrun; parser/record checks are not PDF merge tests. OS support channel remains unestablished.
